cost: Helper scans O(text bytes) plus accumulated prefix copies; external traversal and per-block subprocess limit ten seconds are unexecuted effects. Output memory grows with report rows.
description: External Octave test extraction, lexical scope filter and subprocess report harness; only synthetic extraction helpers run here.
forward: files recursively sorts candidate m/cc paths. blocks collects column-zero %! directives with shared initialization and accumulated functions; calls/assigned approximate builtin scope. Ignored measurement launches timeout per selected block and classifies hang/crash/error/assert/pass.
inverse: Non-column-zero %! excludes extraction. Unknown directives exclude ordinary test output. Calls filter excludes double-quoted text but does not exclude all comments or single-quoted strings; it is no parser proof.

Same blocks admit arbitrary non-%! implementation text and ignored directives; same call-name set admits many syntactic forms. Report status cannot reconstruct process stderr, only truncated first-error detail survives.
limitations: Partial source-bound model, not semantic proof
Finite synthetic fixtures only; frozen suites/external measurement unexecuted
state: Scope names use HashSet membership; files sorted before processing. Expected-error pattern/id is stripped without matching actual error text.
